ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible surface is dominated by low-intensity pixels (estimated 85-90% dark gray/black) with high-intensity highlights (white) primarily caused by specular reflection from water and white-water spray at the fluke-ocean interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark blob across both lobes. Discrete circular rings of slightly higher intensity (light gray) are located in the medial sections of both the left and right lobes, forming distinct non-contiguous patterns against the dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 120 degrees; the vertex point is partially obscured by dynamic white-water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. The right lobe trailing edge contains at least 7 distinct peaks with pixel amplitudes varying from 8 to 20 pixels. The left lobe exhibits a more attenuated, lower-frequency serration pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edge (partially visible) suggests a convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pixel clusters (rings) of approx. 20-30 pixel diameter detected: two clusters in the mid-medial region of the left lobe and two in the mid-medial region of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, high-contrast linear streaks (white) oriented diagonally on the left lobe, approximately 40-60 pixels in length, breaking the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of circular rosette scarring across both lobes; a deep, irregular V-shaped indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, nearly rectangular 'step' notch feature located on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
